title: Design Snake and Ladder
description: Design a Snake and Ladder game. The board should have 100 cells, with random snakes and ladders. Multiple players should be able to play the game by taking turns rolling a standard 6-sided die.
requirements: The board should have 100 cells (1 to 100).
There are multiple snakes and ladders on the board.
A snake moves a player down, a ladder moves a player up.
Multiple players take turns by rolling a 6-sided die.
The first player to reach exactly cell 100 wins.
If a player rolls a number that exceeds 100, they stay in place.
designPattern: State Pattern for game state, Singleton for the Dice.
designDecisions:
1. Entity Segregation: Board, Dice, Player, and Game are distinct classes.
2. Jump Logic: Modeled Snakes and Ladders as a single 'Jump' concept with a start and end point. This simplifies the Board logic.
3. Turn Management: Used a Queue (Deque) to manage player turns round-robin style.
solidPrinciplesUsed: Single Responsibility Principle (SRP): Dice only rolls, Board only holds layout, Game orchestrates.
Open/Closed Principle (OCP): We can add different types of dice or rules without modifying the Game class.
